newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Negara Indonesia up on BBB rating.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara Indonesia up on BBB rating.

text.p: Shares of state-controlled PT Bank Negara Indonesia continued to rise on the Jakarta stock market on Thursday after Standard and Poor's Corp gave the bank's $145 million notes issue a BBB long-term rating, brokers said.
In late trade, the stock was up 100 rupiah to 1,675 rupiah after touching a new high of 1,700 rupiah.
It was the most active stock on the regular board with 64.4 million shares changing hands. It cross-traded at a price of 1,675 rupiah on a volume of 4.7 million shares.
An analyst for a Hongkong-based securities firm said the S&P rating had been expected, but the news still gave the stock an upward push.
"It just added some spice to the stock which has already been hot since last week," the analyst said.
Brokers attributed the bank's strength on the market primarily to continued expectations of higher 1996 earnings coupled with talk of its possible inclusion in Morgan Stanley's capital index.
